Use case: stylized-concept. Create a concept keyframe for Updraft, matching a real-time Three.js game frame. Input image 1 is the STRICT camera, boat geometry, scale, rendering and light reference. Output a single 1664 x 936 landscape image, exact 16:9, no montage.
LOCK THE CAMERA to image 1: behind and above boat, about 24 m back and 6.5 m up, looking ahead. Horizon y=23% of frame. Boat hull approximately x=42–50%, y=59–70%; mast top y=33%; sail occupies x=46–53%. Do not zoom, lower the camera, turn side-on or make a postcard view. Preserve the reference small round wooden dinghy, its stern, upright mast and single patchwork cream/yellow/pale-orange sail to the right of mast. Soft stylised 3D rounded geometry, painterly blue sea, luminous warm haze and golden sun glitter from ahead-left. NOT a hand-drawn anime illustration or photoreal photograph.
One small 1.1 m girl sits facing forward, orange hooded coat and red scarf. Grey baby swan has head and long grey neck emerging from her brown satchel, its bandaged left wing contained in satchel. No separate swimming bird, no adult white swan. Nobody looks at camera. Remove reference whale and its spout; destination island is fully lost in haze.
Encounter: long soft green island-type grass grows directly out of open seawater, swaying on the swell. NO solid ground, shore, raised turf, floating island or reeds. Visible blue water and gold glints between clumps even in dense areas. Grass blades 0.45–0.85 m tall, occasional 1 m tips; soft broad tapered blades, not wheat heads. A 70 m wide by 100 m long meadow with irregular 15–20 m feathered edges: scattered tufts, then grass, then scattered tufts and open sea. Boat sails straight through. Keep the distant half of the seascape open and hazy.
Only physical grass and flowers answer the wind. Never a cursor, hand icon, luminous trail, sparkles, magical glow, lettering, UI, logos, extra people, country landmarks.
KEYFRAME 1 — INTO THE MEADOW. Boat just entering the near feathered edge: dense grassy water starts just ahead of and beside the bow, extends into the middle distance, and dissolves again well below the horizon. Blue sea remains clearly visible in the bottom foreground, with scattered tufts extending behind the boat. Hull pushes the grass sideways in a curved bow wave touching the hull; behind the stern an approximately 2 m wide, 10 m long narrowing furrow of bent-over blades with blue water between, already lifting upright at its far end. Make the bent blades legible near the boat rather than replacing them with foam. Girl leans modestly toward the left gunwale, a small visible orange sleeve and hand reaching down to brush nearby tips, seated safely. Grey cygnet neck raised beside her, facing the passing grass. Untouched green meadow, no flower ribbons yet and no active wind lines. Calm, beautiful, dreamlike. Keep exactly the reference hull and sail size and position.
outputs.refinement_prompt: Edit this concept frame with a precise local character-pose correction. Keep the camera, horizon, boat hull, mast, entire patchwork sail, sea, lighting, grass distribution, furrow, and all framing unchanged. Make her lean slightly toward the LEFT gunwale with her left orange sleeve extending visibly over that gunwale, a small bare hand down outside the boat visibly brushing tips of the long grass beside the hull. No extra arm. At her right hip is a BROWN leather satchel with an open flap; replace the ambiguous large white triangular shape inside the boat with this brown satchel. A small GREY baby swan's curved long grey neck and little grey head emerge from that satchel, looking toward the meadow to the right; its body and bandaged left wing are inside the bag and mostly hidden. No adult white swan, no white triangle. Preserve all existing geometry except the girl's small arm pose and satchel/bird correction. Soft stylised 3D game rendering. Single 16:9 landscape frame requested 1664 x 936 pixels. No text or UI.
